messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Spike of GPU prefill OOMs on svc=inference (pool=gpu-pool-3). 23 container restarts in 5m. Pager: @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: Acked — I'm on call and joining the bridge. Can someone paste the alert graph?

incident-bot: https://telemetry/redwood/alerts/8463729102 - runbook: /runbooks/prefill-oom-handoff

jamie_sre: joining. Quick triage: pod inference-abc-xyz shows repeated 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY' and kernel OOM kills: 'Killed process 1234 (python) total-vm...'
Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:47:12Z inference-abc-xyz python[1234]: RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: out of memory
kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (python) score 987 or sacrifice child
```
Prefill path appears to be long-context (>32k tokens) requests triggering large KV allocations.

prateek_ml: Noted. We shipped a change to continuous-batching heuristics in PR#482 yesterday that increases concurrent prefill window to boost throughput. Hypothesis: heuristics + long prompts -> unbounded KV copies when prefill aborts.

maria_support: BetaCorp reported elevated 500s at ~10:47 UTC, about 15% of their requests errored. They flagged as customer-impacting.

alice_oncall: Mitigation plan (short): 1) reduce batching concurrency to limit simultaneous big-prefill ops 2) enable fallback to smaller-context model for >24k tokens 3) apply rate-limit on very large prompts at the gateway. Implementing step 1 now.

jamie_sre: Commands I'm running to inspect and act:
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference -o wide
kubectl -n prod logs pod/inference-abc-xyz -c runtime | tail -n 200
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gpu-pool-3 --replicas=4
```
Checking node dmesg and /sys/fs/cgroup memory data.

alice_oncall: Scaled gpu-pool-3 from 12 -> 4 replicas. Watching restart count and OOMs.

incident-bot: Action applied: rate_limit_rule 'prefill_large_prompts' -> 60r/min per tenant at api-gateway.

prateek_ml: Quick hotfix: reverting the new batching thresholds in runtime config to previous safe values. Pushing patch to config service.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rolling-restart inference-runtime config=legacy-batching @8463729145

jamie_sre: After restart, one pod still OOMing. Stack shows a KV allocation spike inside prefill loop when a request is aborted mid-prefill. Quick temp workaround: enable KV eviction-on-complete and force drop cache between requests. Patching runtime flags on pods.

alice_oncall: KV eviction toggled on 2/4 pods. Error rate for affected customers dropped from ~15% -> ~1.2% over the last 6m.

maria_support: BetaCorp confirms traffic normalized. They reported a handful of retries but no data loss. They've asked for a postmortem.

jamie_sre: Root cause hypothesis: regression in PR#482 where aborted prefill paths duplicated KV buffers instead of freeing them. Steps: revert heuristics, add regression test that simulates aborted prefill + large context, and add telemetry for per-request KV allocation sizes.

alice_oncall: Marking Sev2 for now. Owning incident until fix merged and rolled out. Will keep the incident open for postmortem.

prateek_ml: Created PR#491 with fix + unit/regression tests + a small runtime toggle to cap KV duplication. Requesting canary rollout.

maria_support: Drafted customer-facing note: 'We experienced transient 500s caused by GPU memory pressure during very large-context prefill requests. We applied mitigations (reduced batching, rate limits, runtime fallback) and deployed a code fix. Monitoring continues; full postmortem will follow.' Want me to send to impacted customers now?

alice_oncall: Yes please send to BetaCorp and the impacted-custs list. Include timeline and expected time for postmortem (~2-3 business days).

jamie_sre: Follow-ups: add per-request KV allocation metric, increase e2e regression coverage for long-context aborts, and revise batching heuristic rollout checklist. Schedule postmortem in 90m.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: alice_oncall. Links: runbook, PR#491, telemetry graph.

alice_oncall: Thanks team — I'll keep the channel updated as PR rolls out and when postmortem is scheduled.
